reason: The cited evidence does not mention Y2O3 or its use in refractory high-entropy alloys. E1 discusses thermal stability from reactive element solid solution, not oxide dispersoids. E2 describes Orowan strengthening from intragranular precipitates in a different alloy, not Y2O3. E3 shows TiC dispersoids in tungsten improve thermal/irradiation resistance, but this is a different material system and dispersoid. None of the key premises about Y2O3 in RHEAs are directly supported.
